Back to the [report](../../README.md#step-5a-holocene-against-anthropocene). Scripts:
`R/pipeline/13_era_models.R` (Step 5a), `R/pipeline/14_predictor_models.R` (Step 5),
`R/pipeline/15_contributions.R` (Step 6). Shared GLS helpers in `R/helpers/reconstruction_models.R`
and `R/helpers/tracking_model_reporting.R`. Every model is fitted on the lake-periods and the plot
pairs of `output/12_tracking/cca_tracking_both_eras.csv`.

## Era models (Step 5a)

```{r}
read_output('era_comparison/era_model_summary.csv') |>
  transmute(Response = response, n, `AR(1)` = AR1_phi, `Variance parameters` = gsub(';', ', ', variance_parameters),
    `R²` = R2, Warnings = coalesce(warnings, '')) |>
  show_table('era_model_summary', caption = paste('**Era models**: estimate ~ period_type * site, AR(1) on the unit',
    'order within series, residual SD per period type and park (relative to Anthropocene MORA) times the',
    'square root of endpoint_var. R² is descriptive.'))
read_output('era_comparison/era_coefficients.csv') |>
  transmute(Response = metric, Term = term, Estimate = estimate, SE = std_error, p = p_value) |>
  show_table('era_coefficients', caption = '**Era-model coefficients** (treatment contrasts, reference Holocene-S at MORA).')
```

```{r}
show_figure('report/figures/models/fig_tracking_model_residuals.pdf', page = 1:2)
```

**Residual checks** of the eight era models (page 1) and of the joint pace and direction model
(page 2). Top: normal quantile plots of the normalized residuals, one per response. Bottom: normalized
residuals by period type and park (points, with boxes for the quartiles). The models have no continuous
predictor, so the fitted values take one value per period type and park, and residuals by group show
what a plot against fitted values would. The climate change rate, the climate change, the turnover
rate and the displacement are positive by construction and their residuals are right-skewed. The lag, lag rate, pace and direction residuals have
heavy tails from a few Anthropocene plots.

## Joint pace and direction model

```{r}
joint = 'era_comparison/joint_correction_effects'
read_output(file.path(joint, 'model_group_means.csv')) |>
  transmute(Park = site, `Period type` = period_type, Correction = correction, n, Mean = estimate,
    `95% CI` = sprintf('%.3f to %.3f', conf_low, conf_high)) |>
  show_table('joint_correction_means', caption = paste('**Joint model** estimate ~ period_type * site * correction,',
    'paired AR(1): fitted means.'))
read_output(file.path(joint, 'correction_contrasts.csv')) |>
  transmute(Park = site, `Period type` = period_type, Contrast = contrast, Estimate = estimate,
    `95% CI` = sprintf('%.3f to %.3f', conf_low, conf_high), `p (Holm)` = p_adjusted) |>
  show_table('joint_correction_contrasts', caption = '**Direction minus pace** within each period type and park.')
read_output(file.path(joint, 'correlation_parameters.csv')) |>
  transmute(Parameter = parameter, Estimate = estimate) |>
  show_table('joint_correction_correlation', caption = paste('**Correlation parameters**: AR(1) on the unit order,',
    'and the correlation between the pace and direction of one unit per era and park.'))
```

## Holocene explanatory models (Step 5)

```{r}
read_output('community_predictor_models/model_performance.csv') |>
  transmute(Response = response, Era = era, Model = model, n, MORA = n_MORA, NOCA = n_NOCA, `R²` = R2,
    `AR(1)` = AR1_phi, `SD ratio NOCA/MORA` = sd_ratio_NOCA_to_MORA) |>
  show_table('explanatory_model_performance', caption = '**Explanatory models**: rows, descriptive R² and covariance parameters.')
read_output('community_predictor_models/model_exclusions.csv') |> count(response, period_type, site, exclusion) |>
  rename(Response = response, `Period type` = period_type, Park = site, Reason = exclusion, Rows = n) |>
  show_table('explanatory_model_exclusions', caption = '**Rows left out of the explanatory models.**')
```

## Species means (Step 6)

```{r}
read_output('species_contribution_models/species_contrasts.csv') |>
  transmute(Measure = measure, Species = species, Park = site, Contrast = contrast, Estimate = estimate,
    `95% CI` = ifelse(is.na(conf_low), 'not defined', sprintf('%.3f to %.3f', conf_low, conf_high)), p = p_value) |>
  show_table('species_contrasts', caption = '**Species contrasts between period types** (Welch differences of means).')
read_output('species_contribution_models/noca_burned_species_means.csv') |>
  transmute(Measure = measure, Species = species, Burned = burned, n, Mean = estimate,
    `95% CI` = ifelse(interval_defined, sprintf('%.3f to %.3f', conf_low, conf_high), 'not defined')) |>
  show_table('noca_burned_species_means', caption = '**NOCA species contributions on burned and unburned plots** (means with t-intervals).')
read_output('cca_transition_contributions/species_lake_periods.csv') |>
  transmute(Park = site, Lake = lake, Period = period, Species = species, `contrib_climate` = contrib_climate,
    `contrib_gap` = contrib_gap) |>
  show_table('species_lake_periods', caption = '**Species contributions per lake-period** (CCA distance per century).')
```
